name: Claude Code Review

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  claude-code-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run Claude Code Action
        id: claude-code-action
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
        with:
          trigger_phrase: '@claude'
          allowed_non_write_users: ${{ github.actor }}
          include_comments_by_actor: true
          exclude_comments_by_actor: false
          prompt: |
            You are Claude, a helpful AI assistant. If you see an issue or comment mentioning "@claude", please explore the issue and provide your thoughts or suggestions.

      - name: Update comment with Claude's response
        id: update-comment
        uses: edumserrano/find-create-or-update-comment@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          issue-number: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          comment-author: ${{ github.actor }}
          body-includes: '@claude'
          body: ${{ steps.claude-code-action.outputs.conclusion || '' }}
          edit-mode: replace

yaml:
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  claude-code-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run Claude Code Action
        id: claude-code-action
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
        with:
          trigger_phrase: '@claude'
          allowed_non_write_users: ${{ github.actor }}
          include_comments_by_actor: true
          exclude_comments_by_actor: false
          prompt: |
            You are Claude, a helpful AI assistant. If you see an issue or comment mentioning "@claude", please explore the issue and provide your thoughts or suggestions.

      - name: Update comment with Claude's response
        id: update-comment
        uses: edumserrano/find-create-or-update-comment@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          issue-number: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          comment-author: ${{ github.actor }}
          body-includes: '@claude'
          body: ${{ steps.claude-code-action.outputs.conclusion || '' }}
          edit-mode: replace
